name: cron
description: Schedule recurring tasks with cron expressions — run shell commands, HTTP requests, or AI agent jobs on a timer with full audit history
author: Kyle Boyer <https://github.com/KyleBoyer>

jobs.description: Cron job definitions keyed by ID

requireAgentApproval.description: When enabled, cron jobs created or modified by the AI agent are saved disabled and must be approved in the Cron panel before they will run.

blockPrivateHttpTargets.description: When enabled, HTTP cron jobs will refuse to connect to loopback, link-local, or private (RFC1918) addresses.
